title: SMProfile-MaterialLot payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/material/material-lot.json 2.4.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

material_lot_no.description: Identity of the material lot (join key). Often kept in the ERP as 'Charge/batch number' — here correctly as MaterialLot.

article_ref.description: FK to Article.article_no (DEFINED_BY) = MaterialLot.MaterialDefinitionID. The MaterialDefinition of this lot.

status.description: Lot status (ISA-95 MaterialLotProperty / Status), e.g. available, in_production, consumed, blocked.

workorder_ref.description: FK to Workorder.workorder_no, reached via JobOrder REQUIRES_MATERIAL. The order slot that produced this lot.

job_order_ref.description: FK to JobOrder.job_order_no: the job (one workorder operation) that produced this lot. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/material-lot.md, attributes › job_order_ref › description.

location_ref.description: FK to StorageLocation (AT_LOCATION). Current storage location of the lot.

updated_at.description: Last change of the lot; every writer sets it. Cursor of GET /material-lots?updated_since= (sim-v5, Welle 12).

assembly_type.description: ISA-95 AssemblyType: Physical (the parts are physically joined) or Logical (a grouping, e.g. a compound of polymer and filler).

assembly_relationship.description: ISA-95 AssemblyRelationship: Permanent (cannot be taken apart again) or Transient (temporary, e.g. a kit).
